label: vulnerable
explanation: The Apex code is correct and properly enforces FLS and sharing. The vulnerability is entirely in the permission set: it grants ManageInternalUsers to accounts payable clerks whose job is only to review and approve invoices. ManageInternalUsers allows creating, editing and deactivating internal Salesforce users — an administrative capability completely unrelated to invoice approval. Any clerk assigned this permission set gains privileged user management access.
expected_remediation: Remove the ManageInternalUsers userPermission from the permission set
Grant only the minimum permissions needed: Invoice__c read/edit and class access
sources: Salesforce Help - Security Health Check / least privilege
severity_rationale: Severity criteria v1 (10 Nov 2026): ManageInternalUsers grants full user administration to a non-admin role. High = escalation path to user account takeover or privilege escalation across the org.
